ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
ተውህበ: ወሀበ — it was given (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive)
ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
ወበኀበ: ኀበ — and before, with (ወ- + በ- + ኀበ) · and among (ወበኀበ አብዳንሰ 'and among fools')
ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
ሀገረ: ሀገር — city, country (noun; construct 'city of') · accusative 'the city' as object of አዖድዎ ('they led him around the city')
እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ)
ለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — to the king, for the king (ለ- + noun) · marking the object, doubled by a suffix on the verb (ይሕምይዎ ለንጉሥ 'they revile the king') or by a suffix on a noun (ሐሚዮቱ ለንጉሥ 'the reviling of the king')
ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix) · which he gave it (feminine object, the city: ሀገር ዘወሀባ ሰሎሞን)
ኀቤሁ: ኀበ — to him (preposition + -hu, ኀቤሁ) · also 'of him' after ሰአለ 'ask' (ሰአለ ኀቤሁ 'he asked of him')
ለንግሥተ: ንግሥት — to/of the queen of (ለ- naming the possessor + noun, construct)
በአሐቲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- + fem. numeral አሐቲ) · 'by one' (በአሐቲ ፍናው 'by one road')
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ)
ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ኅቡረ: ኅቡር — together (accusative as adverb; from ኅብረ/ኅቡር)
ነገረ: ነገር — word, matter, affair (noun, construct 'word of')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
ትክል: ክህለ — you can (2ms imperfect, G, k-h-l)
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
ትቤሉኒ: ብህለ — you said to me (2mp perfect ትቤሉ + -ኒ 'me'; the perfect of ብህለ is ይቤ, ትቤ, ትቤሉ)
ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
ወተውህበት: ተውህበ — and she was given (ወ- + 3f sg perfect, passive of ወሀበ)
ለእስራኤል: እስራኤል — to Israel, O Israel (ለ- + proper name) · over Israel (ይነግሥ ለእስራኤል 'he shall reign over Israel')
መድኀኒተ: መድኀኒት — salvation, saviour (noun; accusative predicate: 'you will be a salvation', i.e. a saviour)
ለዘመደ: ዘመድ — for the kin of (ለ- + noun, construct 'kin of')
አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"'
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
ኀቤከ: ኀበ — at, with, to (preposition, form ኀቤ- + -ከ 'you', 2ms)
በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
መከረ: መከረ — he took counsel, advised (3ms perf., G, m-k-r)
ሠምረ: ሠምረ — he willed, was pleased (3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
ትኩን: ኮነ — that she be (3fs jussive) · that you be (2ms jussive, ከመ ትኩን ከማሁ 'that you be like him') · let it be (3fs jussive, ትኩን ሞትነ 'may our death be')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion')
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ትኩንከ: ኮነ — may she be to you, for you (3fs jussive, k-w-n, + -ከ '2ms you')
መርሐ: መርሕ — guide, leader (noun, predicate accusative after ይኩንከ; the same spelling could be a 3ms perfect 'he guided') (?)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity') · 'of the world', the owner after an anticipating suffix (ብርሃኖ ለዓለም 'the light of the world')
ወለዘርእከ: ዘርእ — and to your seed (ወ- + ለ- 'to' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
ዐቀብከ: ዐቀበ — you have kept, guarded (2ms perfect, ʿ-q-b)
ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
ፈቀድከ: ፈቀደ — you wished, desired (2ms perfect, G)
ነሢኦታ: ነሥአ — taking her (infinitive ነሢኦት + -ኣ '3fs her' (written -ታ), accusative, n-ś-ʾ)
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ለሊሃ: ለሊሃ — she herself (emphatic pronoun, 3fs; the masculine is ለሊሁ)
ፈቀደት: ፈቀደ — she wished, wanted (3fs perfect, f-ḳ-d)
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
ለኤልምያኖስ: ኤልምያኖስ — Elmeyanos (proper name; ለ- marking the object)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ወአልብሳ: አልበሰ — and clothe her! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of ለበሰ 'wear', l-b-s, + -ኣ '3fs her')
ለእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት — our lady, for/of our lady (ለ- + noun, fem. + -ነ '1cp our'; marks the object, doubled by the suffix of ነሢኦታ)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ተናገረ: ተናገረ — he spoke, conversed (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነገረ)
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ሠለስተ: ሠለስቱ — three (numeral; accusative ሠለስተ before በትረ)
በሰማያት: ሰማይ — in the heavens (በ- 'in' + plural noun)
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
ናእምር: አእመረ — we know, that we may know (1cp subjunctive, root ʿ-m-r)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ለኅሩያኒሁ: ኅሩይ — to his chosen ones (ለ- + plural ኅሩያን + -ሁ 'his')
ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ፍሥሓ: ፍሥሓ — joy (construct 'joy of') · also the plain accusative 'joy' with an adjective (ኀብሩ ፍሥሓ ዐቢየ 'they joined in great joy')
በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
ወተሐሠየ: ተሐሠየ — and he rejoiced (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem; cf. ሐሤት 'joy')
ወምንተ: ምንት — and what? (ወ- 'and' + interrogative pronoun, accusative)
ሚመጠነ: ሚመጠነ — how greatly, how much (interrogative adverb)
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants')
ወያነክሩ: አነከረ — and they marvel (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative; takes accusative object)
ወይሰግዱ: ሰገደ — and they will bow down (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, s-g-d)
